title: neoswga params.json
description: Canonical schema for neoswga pipeline configuration files.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the file was written for. Version 2 corrected several scientific constants (Klenow processivity, phi29 extension rate, the Mg2+ activity model, the AG/TC nearest-neighbour parameter) and changed the mg_conc default from 0.0 to the polymerase buffer value; a v1 file still runs but produces different numbers.

data_dir.description: Directory for pipeline outputs (CSVs, HDF5 caches, logs).

src_dir.description: Source directory; usually equal to data_dir.

fg_genomes.description: Foreground (target) genome FASTA paths, one per target.

fg_prefixes.description: K-mer file prefixes for each foreground genome. Populated by count-kmers.

fg_seq_lengths.description: Per-genome foreground lengths in bp. Auto-computed if missing.

bl_genomes.description: Blacklist genomes; primers matching these are penalized or rejected.

bl_penalty.description: Penalty weight applied to blacklist matches.

max_bl_freq.description: Maximum permissible blacklist frequency; 0 = zero tolerance.

min_k.description: Minimum primer length (bp). Polymerase-aware default is used if absent.

max_k.description: Maximum primer length (bp). Polymerase-aware default is used if absent.

coverage_reach.description: Per-primer extension reach in bp used for set-cover selection and reported fg_coverage. Defaults to the polymerase's realistic per-primer reach (phi29 ~3000, equiphi29 ~4000). Coverage figures are not comparable across different reaches; swga 2.0 reports at ~70000. Estimate from sequencing depth with 'neoswga calibrate-reach --bam'.

occupancy_ranking.description: Rank filter candidates by occupancy-weighted background load rather than exact k-mer counts. Exact counts are 0 for every primer with no perfect background match, which leaves the ranking key undefined for most long primers.

occupancy_shortlist.description: How many survivors to re-rank by occupancy. Taken by the exact-count key first, so nothing that key separates is discarded.

max_mismatches.description: Highest mismatch class counted when ranking step-2 candidates by occupancy-weighted site load. Minimum 1 because the read site (pipeline._configured_positive_int) takes positive integers only; exact-match-only ranking is reached with occupancy_ranking: false instead. Applies to the filter step's ranking; the optimizers carry their own OptimizerConfig.max_mismatches.

sampled_index_path.description: Path to a pre-built sampled background index, used when use_bloom_filter is set and no index is found beside the Bloom filter. Overridden by --sampled-index-path.

mg_conc.description: Mg2+ concentration (mM). Polymerase-aware default is used if absent.

adaptive_gc.description: Enable genome-GC-aware filtering. Set false to force gc_min/gc_max to user values.

optimization_method.description: Optimizer to use. The five canonical methods, the virtual 'ensemble' runner (aliases 'auto'/'all'), or a registered optimizer alias.

k_conc.description: K+ concentration (mM). Sums with na_conc and nh4_conc into ionic strength.

nh4_conc.description: NH4+ concentration (mM). The standard phi29 buffer supplies 20 mM NH4+ as 10 mM (NH4)2SO4.

dntp_conc.description: Total dNTP concentration (mM, sum of all four). Chelates Mg2+ roughly 1:1, lowering free Mg2+.

dtt_mm.description: DTT concentration (mM). Recorded for protocol completeness; no melting-temperature term.

ssb.description: Single-stranded binding protein present. Previously accepted by the CLI but absent from this schema.

propanediol_m.description: 1,2-propanediol (M). GC-rich enhancer; ~5.4 C Tm depression per M (Horakova 2011). Typical 1 M.

max_homopolymer_run.description: Longest run of a single base a primer may contain. From PCR primer design; neither swga 1.0 nor 2.0 applies it.

gc_clamp_window.description: Bases at the 3' end the GC clamp examines. Not scaled to primer length: scaling was measured against per-primer amplification data and admits worse amplifiers.

max_gc_in_clamp.description: Maximum G/C bases allowed within the clamp window. Widened automatically for GC-rich targets.
